name: Melilot
message: 「You didn't manage to capture it at all, did you」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have any advice for us, Melilot?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just thought I'd like to hear it」

name: Azel
message: 「Well, um... might you have any advice?」
Melilot took a sip of black tea, and then,

name: Melilot
message: 「I only take pictures for record-keeping, so I wouldn't know anything technical, though」
Even as she said that, she took another look at the photos for us

name: Melilot
message: 「The camera shake is quite bad. Aren't you taking them purely on impulse?」

name: Azel
message: 「It can't be helped. The subject disappears right away」

name: Melilot
message: 「You don't even have a moment to breathe out?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your posture is actually most stable when you exhale, you see」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, if you press the shutter while breathing out, there will be much less blur」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I heard some kind of noise, but... guess it was just my imagination」
There's no way Azel would be wandering around this late at night anyway.

name: Paqy
message: 「I bet you're just worked up 'cause there's a woman under the same roof」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's a total washboard who's not even fit to be compared to Ria, sure. Still, she's a woman, so it's no wonder you're going into heat, Lord Synn」
Because Paqy said something weird, now it's stuck in my head and I can't fall asleep――.
